title: Full-Day Circle Island Guided Tour of Oahu
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the best of the island in a full-day tour with us. This tour is perfect for first-timers visiting the island as it allows you to make the most out of your day .

 In the Circle Island family tour, we will get to ride between the ocean and the mountains, looking at the gorgeous views. Then We will stop along the way and take a glance at the ocean, we will get to tour a coffee farm where coffee from all over the World gets roasted daily by local farmers. Also, we will look for green sea turtles and surfers on the famous North Shore and taste some delicious Pineapple dole whip, all this while you eat where the locals eat at our favorite food trucks in Kahuku, North Shore!

 We look forward to having a great day touring the Island with you and your family.
